summary: Flood beam pattern chart, specs, and dimensions from the Roadshock 3 in. LED Floodlight box (SKU 64322): 25 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 160 ft, 0.25 lx at 300 ft.
body: This is the flood beam pattern chart printed on the retail box of the Harbor Freight Roadshock 3 in. LED Floodlight, item 64322. Harbor Freight's product page lists 965 lumens and a 335 ft. range, but it doesn't show this chart or any lux readings.

The chart is a top-down view of the beam. The light levels printed along the top line up with the distances printed along the bottom: 25 lx at 30 ft, 1 lx at 160 ft, and 0.25 lx at 300 ft. The side scale runs 90 ft to each side of center. The pattern is a wide oval, typical of a flood beam.

The dimension drawing shows a 3 in. wide, 3 in. deep housing that is 3 in. tall, or 3.5 in. including the mounting bracket. The box also lists lumens, beam distance, color temperature, voltage, and wattage (below).
specs: 3 in. W x 3 in. D x 3 in. H (3.5 in. with bracket)

transcription_notes: The item number at the bottom right is cut off in the photo ("6432..."). The printed specs match Harbor Freight's listing for item 64322.
